contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver denarius Roman republican coin. Probably moneyer Cn. Lentulus. Mint is Rome, 88BC, (Reece period 1). Reverse legend reads (CN.LENTVL) in exergue. Reverse shows Victory in biga right. See RRC p.356, c.f.345/1. Obverse shows helmeted bust of Mars right, wearing Corinthian helmet. Obverse legend reads [...]. Condition is fair, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 2.43g, diameter is 17.51mm.…
